outline: # Pricing & Monetization Psychology
attribution line
## Use a disfluent font for genuine deals — and name tiers for the mix you want
## Price from cost+margin floor and value ceiling — never tarot or competitor-minus-20%
## The freemium trap, in numbers: higher conversion, far lower cash
## Whether freemium works is decided by the cost to serve a free user
## Price is the cheapest money — stop anchoring it to the cheapest competitor
## 1% on price beats 1% on acquisition — you raise prices too little and too late
## Competing on price is adverse selection — you filter in the worst client
## Make the middle plan the one you actually want to sell
## Ask for the card in trial — but optimize for the right ICP, not raw conversion
## Frame the upgrade as a loss at the moment of value, not a feature you're selling
## Engineer the comparison frame with a decoy and a high anchor — and drop Free from the top
## Tie the trial's end to value consumed, not the calendar
## Order pricing rows by the serial-position effect: killer feature first, differentiator last
## Engineer the pricing page with Good-Better-Best and control the comparison
## Build a single value axis, then tune the decoy's distance to your target plan

# Revenue-Centric Design: attribution line (Richard [@richardrx](https://x.com/richardrx), ex-Volkswagen, PayPal, IBM; 134 principles; translated from Portuguese; every principle links its source post) + rule 'Serve the user and the business in every design decision: value and revenue, never one without the other.'

## Usage boundary (required): Never apply to betting, casino, gambling, or real-money games-of-chance products, including loot-box and real-money-gaming mechanics. Decline and state that the author's permission excludes that use. Treat it as a hard constraint.

### Enforcement and hooks: Run scripts/check_usage_boundary.py on every prompt and every file write/edit; block on exit 2. Let only the user create .rcd-boundary-ok in the project root; never create it. Hooks table verbatim (2 rows) + <skill_dir> definition + exit 2/0 bullets + manual-run rule for agents without hooks. Optional maintainer line: expect the guard to flag this skill's own files.

## Workflow (6 steps): 1 read rcd-log.md first, never re-prescribe a failed move, never repeat a pending one; 2 route via the table, open only matching files, scan headings (shape principle → apply when → move → evidence → source); 3 run scripts/revenue_math.py for numbers, never estimate; 4 done = mechanism named + principle cited + evidence/source attached, missing any one = not done; 5 deliver audits in references/audit-template.md shape; 6 append to rcd-log.md, creating it on first use
## Core rules: the RCD spine: single kept copy of the 9 principles in the fuller wording from references/revenue-centric-design.md lines 9-17
## Reference router: 13-row table verbatim + audit-template row; dashboards row lists dashboards-and-data-viz.md and revenue-centric-design.md#make-the-dashboard-answer-what-do-i-do-now
## Visual lines and assets: When a principle has a Visual line, open ../assets/<id>.jpg only if the text is insufficient; otherwise follow the Source link

## Gotchas (6, verbatim content as rules): real scarcity only, never invent counters/timers/stock; loss aversion vs dark pattern line (true claim + easy exit); kill outbound links only on conversion pages, never on blog/docs/SEO pages; 4.2-4.5 stars means letting real criticism show, never fabricate reviews; never answer with 30 A/B tests: compute the sample-size floor first (revenue_math.py sample-size), test big levers, decide by qualitative research below the floor; treat evidence as benchmark not guarantee (mostly Brazilian SaaS, BRL)

## Scripts: revenue_math.py (sample-size, churn-ltv, cac; flags; the 3 docstring examples verbatim in a code block); check_usage_boundary.py (hook mode via stdin JSON, gate mode via paths/text/cwd, exit 0/2, marker)

## Related skills: RCD supplies principle + evidence; execution skills own workflow. External Corey Haines marketingskills (URL): cro, churn-prevention, ab-testing, copywriting, pricing, onboarding. If they are not installed, apply RCD directly. When one runs, cite RCD principles inside it. Optional in-pack pointers: anti-slop (UI execution), anti-ai-slop-escrita-ptbr (PT-BR copy), web-discoverability (SEO/content pages where outbound links stay)

## Project log (rcd-log.md): read at step 1, append at step 6, one entry per engagement; entry code block verbatim (date heading, via, principle, move, result); via-field telemetry rule (narrow description if RCD keeps leading runs an execution skill should own)

notes:
Key decisions for the build step:
1. Keep all 14 reference files with no merges. Each file is one router row, and keeping them 1:1 preserves file-level parity with upstream heliocosta-dev for future syncs. The only content move is the 9-item RCD list, which goes to SKILL.md Core rules as the single copy.
2. Keep all 134 principle headings verbatim as stable IDs. Old rcd-log.md entries, the 'Read with' quotes, the audit-template example and the log example cite them by name. Apply ASD-STE100 to body lines only, with field labels per entry: 'Apply when:', 'Do:' (one imperative rule per line), 'Evidence:', 'Visual:' (description + path verbatim), 'Quote:' (Voice verbatim), 'Source:' (link verbatim). Integrity checks: 7+7+5+13+24+3+6+20+8+15+13+13 = 134 headings; 134 Source lines; 137 unique richardrx status URLs; 44 image citations.
3. Keep Portuguese strings verbatim with their existing English glosses. lp-diagnostic-framework.md has 5 PT quotes and 3 PT failure-mode strings with no gloss; adding an English gloss in parentheses is optional (additive only).
4. Keep 44 referenced images (6.2 MB) under identical .jpg names after recompression; drop 30 unreferenced (3.0 MB). The list comes from a grep of every .md/.py file; no image is referenced but missing, and assets/ holds only JPGs (74, not ~76).
5. Copy both scripts verbatim. Self-trigger risk, verified by running a copy of the guard regex in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/b5341f2f-b2f1-59df-b2b7-aa988024294d/scratchpad/rcd_tools/guard_scan.py (the source script itself was not executed): the guard flags SKILL.md, LICENSE, ai-era line 29, metrics line 19 and pricing line 29. Build and edit these files with the boundary hook disabled. Optionally add one maintainer gotcha line saying so. Do not reword the 'Don't bet your product…' heading (stable ID) or weaken the regex.
6. License compliance is satisfied by: LICENSE verbatim at the root; attribution in frontmatter metadata, the SKILL.md H1 line, a one-line attribution per reference file and every Source link; the gambling/betting/casino ban in the description, the Usage boundary section, the guard script and metadata.usage_restriction.
7. Frontmatter: description is 985 chars with no angle brackets (verified). Quote version '1.3.0' and date '2026-09-17' so YAML parses them as strings. Add a top-level license key. All metadata values are flat strings.
8. Word estimates after rewrite: SKILL.md ~1350 words (~180 lines, under 500), references total ~19,700 words (source ~25,600). Verbatim lists, tables, examples and numbers keep the reduction modest, about 15-25%.
